Done. All 4 existing tests pass unmodified.

- `reportgen/config.py`: frozen dataclass `Config` with the four typed fields and identical defaults; `load_config` validates keys against `fields(Config)` and raises `ValueError: unknown config setting: 'titel'` naming the offender, then constructs `Config(**raw)` so file values override defaults.
- `reportgen/loader.py`, `reportgen/formatter.py`: attribute access.
- `reportgen/main.py` needed no change (it only passes the config along).
- No subscripting of the config remains in `reportgen/`; `tests/` untouched, no commits made.
